modelText:
I proposed starting the Engagement shoot early, and it now waits for a human to approve it.

The Retainer (contract section p1) is paid. The Engagement shoot is the only task that follows it, and it has no outside cost, so it can safely start sooner.

Album order and Final shot list stay as planned. They follow the Second installment (p2) and the Balance (p3), which are both unpaid. Album order is the task with outside cost, and it stays tied to p2.

I did not choose the "keep the planned dates" option, because it would leave the Engagement shoot waiting for no reason.
